subject.title: [Bug]: agent --json returns pre-hook assistant text instead of finalized before_message_write output

question: When `before_message_write` rewrites or blocks the final CLI assistant message, what should `agent --json` return in `payloads` and metadata?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally allow raw CLI output in JSON even when persistence is rewritten or blocked, so fixing the bug requires an explicit security/product choice for blocked-hook output rather than only moving code.

options.title: Return finalized hook output
options.body: Use the hook-mutated assistant text for JSON payloads and return no raw assistant payload plus safe blocked metadata when the hook blocks persistence.

options.title: Preserve raw CLI payloads
options.body: Keep JSON as a raw runner-output surface and document that it may diverge from transcript hooks, accepting the policy-leak risk.

options.title: Defer to broader hook unification
options.body: Hold this issue for a shared outbound/finalization seam that also resolves the related lifecycle-hook coverage gaps.

recommendation.title: Return finalized hook output
recommendation.body: Use the hook-mutated assistant text for JSON payloads and return no raw assistant payload plus safe blocked metadata when the hook blocks persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: The current CLI-harness work and original hook merge history make this the best available owner for the CLI JSON/security semantics decision.
